name: voxelhorizon
description: VoxelHorizon — Original 3D Voxel Sandbox for Android (Capacitor + Three.js)

scripts.prepare-www: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','textures.js','world.js','entities.js','game.js'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/three/build/three.min.js','www/three.min.js'); console.log('Prepared www/ with offline three.min.js');"
